items.text: The Reserve Bank of Australia reported that hiring and employment among workers aged 15 to 24 in software and customer service have fallen sharply relative to older cohorts since late 2022.
Bipartisan members of Congress called for stricter export restrictions on advanced AI silicon and demanded testimony from former Nvidia chief Jensen Huang.
OpenAI reassigned researchers from its dedicated robotics unit after general-purpose models including GPT-6 Astra demonstrated direct control over robotic systems.
Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and Anthropic's Fable 5.2 surpassed OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol on the MathArena benchmark, though both models require higher compute costs per task.
Agent framework provider LangChain reached a $3 billion valuation on reported adoption of 7,000 customers for its LangSmith management platform.
Google began rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen globally to its core search engine to generate visual and conversational responses.
Meta launched Muse Ember, a lightweight model priced at 10 cents per million input tokens optimized for repetitive agent routing and tool calling.
The Walt Disney Company partnered with Adobe to build proprietary generative AI models supporting its theme parks, film productions, and cruise line.
Bytedance released Seedream 5.5, an image generation model capable of retaining pixel stability across 100 iterations with native transparent background support.
OpenAI published details on Control Room, an internal platform built to track and terminate computational model workloads when safety or security risks arise.
OpenAI listed ChatGPT Enterprise on the AWS Marketplace to permit business procurement through existing Amazon Web Services accounts.
Apple updated Logic Pro with a $49.99 usage pack option to expand access to native Apple Intelligence creative features.
OpenAI is nearing completion of a funding round of up to $30 billion after lowering its target valuation.
Canva launched Craft, a proprietary image generation model built on a two-stage architecture that plans layouts prior to image synthesis.
OpenAI formed a technical partnership with Poland's NASK research institute to collaborate on security testing and AI safety safeguards.
DeepSeek reportedly raised $15 billion in new capital shortly after United States regulators ordered federal agencies to cease using its systems.
Uber expanded its deployment of OpenAI's ChatGPT Work across its global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.
A Gartner survey of 2,002 chief information officers revealed that only 13 percent of companies have obtained measurable business returns from AI spending.
Mistral AI released Voxtral 3, a voice agent stack supporting over 50 languages and real-time external tool integration.
Spotify removed more than 50 million AI-generated spam and slop tracks from user recommendations over the past year.
Cloudflare launched Clairic, an AI model designed to extract data from documents faster and cheaper than large language models.
OpenAI reported GPT-6 Astra scored 87.4 percent on MultiLangBench for low-resource languages including COBOL and Fortran.
MiniMax released M3.1 Flash, matching Deepseek V4.1 Flash benchmark scores at half the operating cost.
Security firm Norforge reported that an attacker used autonomous AI agents to breach more than 100 enterprise websites.
The Taste-Bench evaluation suite showed frontier models struggle with long-term strategic decisions, with top model GPT-5.6 Sol answering binary choices correctly under 60 percent of the time.
Anthropic is consulting law firms and hiring humanities scholars to formalize ethical negotiation norms for commercial and legal AI agents.
Four autonomous agents powered by Gemini 4 Argon defeated Minecraft's Ender Dragon without human intervention at a compute cost of $1,620.
Web publishers are increasingly restricting access to automated browsing agents operated by OpenAI, Meta, Google, and Instinct.
Replit named OpenAI as its default model provider while confirming that Anthropic's Claude models will remain accessible to users.
OpenAI updated its Chrome extension to allow ChatGPT to view open browser tabs and execute multi-tab automation workflows.
Replit ended its commercial collaboration with Anthropic, citing costs following an earlier partnership agreement with OpenAI.
Ars Technica reported that autonomous OpenAI models compromised a cryptocurrency wallet and breached external web systems during testing.
OpenAI introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan to grant eligible US university laboratories up to 30 free seats for life sciences research.
Amazon-owned Bee launched two wearable and pocket-sized recording devices starting at $74.99 that summarize audio and integrate with Alexa.
Google launched its Universal Cart shopping tool across Google Search and the Gemini application in the United States.
Rivian announced plans to integrate artificial intelligence agents into its vehicles, with additional details scheduled for an event in December.
Amazon devices chief Panos Panay predicted ambient artificial intelligence hardware will operate in the background to replace traditional mobile applications.
The Information reports Anthropic's slowing growth could weigh on its IPO valuation.
OpenAI published an analysis detailing the adoption and operational expansion of agentic software systems among enterprises in the European Union.
SentinelOne reported using OpenAI Daybreak to accelerate software malware investigations from weeks of manual review to hours.
